lunch.name: Feijoada (Brazilian Black Bean Stew)
lunch.description: Brazilian national lunch - hearty black bean stew with pork and sausage. Evolved from plantation cuisine
instructions: In large pot, heat oil, sauté onion and garlic
Add pork, brown on all sides
Add beans, bay leaves and water to cover by 2 inches
Bring to boil, reduce heat, simmer 3 hours
Serve with rice, sautéed collard greens and orange slices on side
lunch.notes: Long cooking time essential for tender meat and creamy beans. Tastes better the next day
lunch.fun_fact: Feijoada is Brazilian national lunch, evolved from plantation cuisine as slave food. Now beloved dish across all social classes
